name: Echowomb
source:
A short visual novel about a conversation between us and our inner fear, how we confront them, live alongside them, and make our own choices. 

[From [url=https://lesliezeng.itch.io/echowomb]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的视觉小说，讲述我们与内心恐惧之间的对话，我们如何面对它们，与它们一起生活，并做出我们自己的选择。

[来自[url=https://lesliezeng.itch.io/echowomb]Itch.io[/url]]
